title: LA Colossal – Gamji-geumni 06 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Black British woman in her late 30s, natural hair in a high sculpted bun with a gold pin, natural face with a confident smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips filling the armchair, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body gamji-geumni body painting in the style of Goryeo illuminated sutra covers, from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface. Glossy deep navy-indigo base, not purple, with bold dense shimmering gold ink line work — lotus medallions, vine scrolls, and stacked lotus-petal borders. No plain indigo areas, no religious figures. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated in a carved rosewood armchair, torso turned open toward the camera, one forearm on the armrest, the other hand on her thigh, legs crossed at the knee. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch indigo lacquer pointed platform stiletto ankle booties with gold line detailing.
Nails: Extra long coffin nails, indigo with gold stripe.

Background & Lighting: Scholar's study with bookcases of indigo-bound volumes and a brass lamp, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm lamp light with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
